text:
mira: FYI customer 'Lumina' just flagged that their April invoice (INV-2026-04-1234) is ~18% higher than the CSV export we provided for 2026-04-01..2026-04-30. CSV (console export) shows 2,100,342 tokens; invoice shows 2,487,512. CSV live at s3://redwood-exports/lumina/2026-04/tokens.csv. Can someone triage?

alex: Pinging billing + runtime. Do we know which tokenization/version the console CSV uses for that bucket? We changed export schema in March, right? @jonathan @tara

jonathan: Billing side: invoices are computed from raw_events aggregation (tokens_agg_v2). Exports may be produced by a separate pipeline. Need sample rows/message_ids to diff; can you paste a few lines from the CSV?

mira: pasted sample lines from the customer CSV:
```
message_id,role,tokens
msg_01a,system,12
msg_01b,user,45
msg_01c,assistant,function_call,0
msg_01d,assistant,reply,102
```
Note: the exported CSV schema has a "tokens" column that looks lower than expected for function_call rows.

tara: quick hypothesis: on 2026-03-15 we rolled tokenizer v2 which changed how function_call/system sequences are tokenized (and how we surface totals in exports). The billing pipeline always aggregates from raw_events which were backfilled with v2 counts. If the export generation job for older buckets used a cached tokenizer mapping or an old transform, it could have dropped the function_call.total_tokens field or not sum nested parts.

alex: can you run a targeted diff? Something like: join raw_events.message_id -> exports CSV on message_id and compare raw_events.tokens_total vs csv.tokens for that customer/date range. Example SQL: 
```sql
select e.message_id, re.tokens_total as raw_tokens, ex.tokens as csv_tokens, (re.tokens_total - ex.tokens) as delta
from raw_events re
left join exports_csv ex on re.message_id = ex.message_id
where re.customer_id = 'lumina' and re.event_date between '2026-04-01' and '2026-04-30'
order by delta desc limit 20;
```

export-bot: regen-export job queued: regen_exports --customer lumina --start 2026-04-01 --end 2026-04-30 --tokenizer v2 (run id queued: run-20260412-01)

jonathan: I dug into the invoice calc for INV-2026-04-1234 — invoice_total_tokens = 2,487,512 coming from tokens_agg_v2. The shortfall (invoice - CSV) = 387,170 tokens. The top deltas cluster on messages where role IN ("system","assistant") and where metadata->>'function_call' IS NOT NULL. Looks like CSV transform may have skipped adding function_call.total_tokens.

mira: Customer asks for timeline and whether we'll provide a corrected CSV + reconciliation. Can we run a backfill/regeneration and then compare? They'll want the corrected export before billing next steps.

tara: Plan: run one-off backfill/regeneration using tokenizer v2 to produce a new tokens_regen.csv for April. I'll own the job. Command I'm running: 
```bash
./tools/regen_exports --customer lumina --start 2026-04-01 --end 2026-04-30 --tokenizer v2 --out s3://redwood-exports/lumina/2026-04/tokens_regen.csv
```
Estimate ~45 minutes. After regen I'll run the diff SQL to confirm parity with raw_events. If regen matches billing totals we can provide CSV + reconciliation and then billing will decide if invoice adjustment needed. @jonathan please prepare audit checks.

jonathan: OK. If the regen makes the CSV match raw_events and changes invoice-exposed totals, we will evaluate adjustments. Need: (1) before/after token sums, (2) audit log for regen run id, (3) dollar impact calc. If delta <= 5% we typically issue a credit; if >5% need escalation.

export-bot: run-20260412-01 started: regenerating exports for lumina 2026-04-01..2026-04-30. logs -> https://logs.redwood.internal/run-20260412-01

mira: I'll update the customer saying "we found a tokenization mismatch in exports vs billing aggregation; we're running a one-off regen of your April export with corrected tokenizer and will send the updated CSV + reconciliation within the hour." :thumbsup:

export-bot: run-20260412-01 progress 12%... 46k/400k messages processed.

export-bot: run-20260412-01 completed: success. output: s3://redwood-exports/lumina/2026-04/tokens_regen.csv (sha256: a3f1...)

tara: Quick diff result after regen: regen sum = 2,487,504 tokens; raw_events aggregate = 2,487,512 tokens; CSV original = 2,100,342. Regen matches billing within 8 tokens (rounding). So root cause confirmed: old export transform dropped function_call token counts.

alex: SQL check we ran: 
```sql
select sum(re.tokens_total) as raw_sum, sum(coalesce(ex.tokens,0)) as csv_sum, sum(coalesce(re.tokens_total,0) - coalesce(ex.tokens,0)) as gap
from raw_events re
left join exports_csv ex on re.message_id = ex.message_id and ex.source = 's3://redwood-exports/lumina/2026-04/tokens.csv'
where re.customer_id = 'lumina' and re.event_date between '2026-04-01' and '2026-04-30';
-- raw_sum = 2487512, csv_sum = 2100342, gap = 387170
```

jonathan: I'll run invoice-delta calc now and post recommended action. If regen changes billed token count, we'll compute $ impact and either issue credit or a corrected invoice depending on thresholds. I'll post final decision here.

mira: Thanks team. I'll send the regen CSV and a short reconciliation note to the customer. Will hold on refund wording until billing confirms. Closing once billing posts final.
